WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-82.45315 40.638291, -82.33846 40.638456, -82.338257 40.622613, -82.336744 40.554736, -82.359377 40.552312, -82.374664 40.550743, -82.451842 40.550518, -82.45315 40.638291))', 4326) AS g
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g)
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(rast))).mean AS elevation
FROM clipped;
